notes.title: Thank you BUSAN BIC 2025！
notes.notes: [p]Spent an unforgettable three days in Busan!  [/p][p]Met many players who loved my game, which filled me with determination.  [/p][p]Thank you to all the players who tried the game during BIC – your support means everything!  [/p][p]I'll keep updating the demo version, so stay tuned for more![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Midnight Billiards" Playtest is now open for a limited time!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am Hade, the developer of the game.

My solo-developed game "Midnight Billiards" has now opened its Playtest version!
The test is expected to last for three weeks, from May 14, 2025 to June 4, 2025.

Thank you for playing!
